source.title: On some open problems in cone metric space over Banach algebra

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document 7007647. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/7007647 returned a Cloudflare challenge with HTTP 403, so the web interface was classified as blocked_or_challenged. The official zbMATH API record was reachable after the API terms gate and identified the exact work as On some open problems in cone metric space over Banach algebra, by A. Ahmed, Z. D. Mitrovic, and J. N. Salunke, Journal of Linear and Topological Algebra 6(4), 261-267 (2017), with journal link http://jlta.iauctb.ac.ir/article_536118.html. The API record was used only as resolver metadata, not as the technical source for extraction.

Failure mode classified as network_or_dns_failure for the exact journal candidate. Fetches of http://jlta.iauctb.ac.ir/article_536118.html and https://jlta.iauctb.ac.ir/article_536118.html timed out during hostname resolution. The r.jina.ai recovery fetch for the same URL also reported that the hostname could not be resolved.

Bounded exact-work recovery did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source. Search attempts included the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the article id article_536118, and the exact title plus authors Ahmed, Mitrovic, and Salunke. Inspected candidates were rejected because they were different later works that merely cite the target, publication-list metadata pages, or report/CV PDFs that only list the citation and do not contain the target paper's problem statements.

No readable primary source artifact containing the technical problem statements was recovered. The source adequacy gate prevents extracting open problems from zbMATH metadata, editorial summaries, related papers, search snippets, or citation-only publication lists.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-7007647.json and outputs/latest.json.
